figures.caption: Fig. 3. Simulation with AR(1) noise: reconstruction SNR versus autocorrelation coefficient φ (K=15 events per type, σ=0.1, overlapping events). Colored SURE (Theorem 2) closely tracks the oracle at all φ; white SURE loses up to 0.7 dB at intermediate φ.

Fig. 8. Normalized frequency response of regularization kernels learned by SURE(kernel) on each dataset (K = 5). The gray dotted line shows the fixed [1,−2, 1] reference. The learned structures range from pure smoothness (Simulation, ECG) to a mix of smoothness and ridge (auditory ERP) to ridgedominated (P300), reflecting the spectral characteristics of each signal.
